description: This file contains unit tests for the TeamsHttpStream class, verifying its streaming behavior, message content, entity handling, and lifecycle management using the Vitest testing framework.

classes.name: TeamsHttpStream
classes.description: A class responsible for managing streaming messages to Microsoft Teams, including initial typing indicators, streaming chunks, and finalization.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the current stream with new text, possibly triggering a streamed message if character thresholds are met.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Ends the streaming process, sending any remaining content as a final message.

methods.name: sendInformativeUpdate
methods.description: Sends an initial indicator (like 'Thinking...') and establishes a stream ID for subsequent chunks.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Property indicating whether the stream has received any content.

methods.name: isFailed
methods.description: Property indicating if the streaming process has failed or timed out.

ctags.name: activity
ctags.pattern: /^    const activity = sent[0] as Record<string, unknown>;$/

ctags.name: channelData
ctags.pattern: /^    const channelData = finalActivity.channelData as Record<string, unknown>;$/

ctags.name: chunk
ctags.pattern: /^    const chunk = sent[1] as Record<string, unknown>;$/

ctags.name: entities
ctags.pattern: /^    const entities = activity.entities as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;$/

ctags.name: entities
ctags.pattern: /^    const entities = chunk.entities as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;$/

ctags.name: entities
ctags.pattern: /^    const entities = finalActivity!.entities as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;$/

ctags.name: entities
ctags.pattern: /^    const entities = firstActivity.entities as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;$/

ctags.name: finalActivity
ctags.pattern: /^    const finalActivity = sent.find((a) => (a as Record<string, unknown>).type === "message") as$/

ctags.name: firstActivity
ctags.pattern: /^    const firstActivity = sent[0] as Record<string, unknown>;$/

ctags.name: stream
ctags.pattern: /^    const stream = new TeamsHttpStream({ sendActivity, throttleMs: 1 });$/
